bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated on the Biography (BIOS) dataset by computing the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-GAP) and Demographic Parity (DP) for profession classification across binary gender labels, as well as probing intermediate representations to measure gender attribute leakage.

Evaluated using a synthetic Biased MNIST dataset by measuring Demographic Parity and TPR-GAP on digit classification tasks, where the background color acts as a protected attribute that is spuriously correlated with the target digit classes.
